config.name: qwen-vl-3b-parser-sample
notes: SAMPLE: the first 3 clean and the first 3 scanned invoices only (6 documents), not the full 24
parser: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct Q4_K_M + mmproj Q8_0 zero-shot page-to-Markdown (prompt in backend/vlm_parser.py), pages rendered at 110 dpi (VLM_DPI), llama-cpp-python, 4 CPU cores
the VLM parsed in its own pass (both models do not fit in memory together); parse timings are from that pass and are replayed here
extractor: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct Q4_K_M, as in the other LLM runs
arithmetic checks re-scored on the stored predictions after the tax_rate fallback was fixed (tax between 8% and 10% of the subtotal passes when lines carry no rate); evidence results untouched
